card.one_sentence_claim: Gauge invariance is not an extra postulate but a forced consequence of SBT's OI-EI principle plus the Lean-certified Leibniz-quotient factorization theorem: once gauge-equivalent field configurations are declared empirically indiscernible at a layer, the physical configuration space is necessarily the orbit quotient A/G and the only observables are the gauge-invariant (quotient-definable) functions, with Wilson loops as the canonical instance and Faddeev-Popov/Gribov-Singer reappearing as the F15a selection obstruction.
card.target_known_fact: Gauge principle: physical observables are the gauge-invariant functions; gauge-equivalent configurations are physically identical and must be quotiented to the physical configuration space A/G; Wilson loops (traces of holonomy) are the canonical gauge-invariant observables; Faddeev-Popov gauge fixing carries the Gribov-Singer obstruction (no continuous global section of the gauge-orbit projection).
card.scientific_domain: Gauge theory / quantum field theory foundations (symmetry as redundancy elimination)
card.argument_family: symmetry-emergence (redundancy elimination via a universal quotient property)
card.minimum_viable_result: A short structural theorem-with-instantiation: GIVEN a declared gauge group G and the assumption that gauge-related configurations are empirically indiscernible (the bridge lemma as a HYPOTHESIS, not derived), OI-EI + the Lean-certified Leibniz factorization force (i) physical state space = A/G and (ii) observables = gauge-invariant functions, with Wilson loops as the F18 instance and Gribov-Singer as the F15a selection obstruction. Already essentially assembled across the Quantum paper (OI-EI, thm:leibniz-quotient) and Foundations IV (F2/F15a/F18 gauge instantiations); the MVP is a one-section synthesis explicitly chaining them, honestly flagging the bridge lemma as an imported hypothesis.
data_matched: No empirical dataset: the target is the structural gauge principle, not a measured quantity (0 data points).

Recovers (qualitatively, by reproduction): physical configuration space A/G; observables = gauge-invariant functions; Wilson loops as canonical gauge-invariant observables; Faddeev-Popov gauge fixing; Gribov-Singer no-continuous-global-section obstruction. All cited (Peskin-Schroeder, Wilson 1974, Faddeev-Popov 1967, Singer); none re-derived at continuum level.

Optional finite sanity demonstration: a small finite group G acting on a finite configuration set, computing A/~, verifying observables = invariant functions, exhibiting a finite analogue of a Gribov obstruction (an orbit with no equivariant section) using existing Lean lemmas. Proves the machinery executes; proves nothing about continuum Yang-Mills.
card.baseline_comparison: SBT does NOT do better than the standard account on any predictive or computational measure; it RECOVERS the standard gauge principle and REORGANIZES its motivation. The standard account already says observables are gauge-invariant and the physical space is A/G; SBT's added value is purely conceptual/unificatory: a single Lean-certified universal property (refuse empirically silent surplus structure -> forced quotient) makes gauge redundancy, decoherence pointer-quotients, no-signalling, contextuality and coarse-graining instances of ONE move, and slots Gribov gauge-fixing pathology into the generic F15a selection obstruction. It does NOT predict the gauge group, locality, the connection/curvature structure, or Yang-Mills dynamics -- exactly the contentful part of gauge theory -- because that is the missing lens-selection interface. Equal predictive content, strictly weaker on the substantive physics (gauge-group selection), with a genuine but modest gain in conceptual economy.
card.why_scientists_care: It offers a principled, mechanized answer to 'why must gauge redundancy be quotiented?' -- not as an ad hoc convention but as a forced consequence (GIVEN the bridge hypothesis) of refusing to reify distinctions no experiment can witness, identical to the move used for coarse-graining and no-signalling. If the same universal property genuinely underlies gauge invariance, decoherence pointer-quotients, and contextuality, that is an attractive structural unification of 'redundancy elimination' across physics and logic, and it suggests Gribov/Faddeev-Popov gauge-fixing obstructions are instances of a generic equivariant-section obstruction.

card.honest_status_note: Class-B REORGANIZATION, not a derivation. The papers themselves hedge: the Quantum paper says only 'analogous to quotienting gauge redundancy' (line 126, verified), and the F2 gauge instantiation states the gauge group G is 'given a priori' (Foundations IV line 2383, verified). The Leibniz universal property is genuinely Lean-certified but is 'standard quotient mathematics' (Quantum line 159, verified); the substantive content is the methodological OI-EI premise plus the bridge identification (gauge orbit = empirical equivalence), and that bridge presupposes the physics it claims to motivate (circularity risk). Minor citation slip in the candidate: Wilson loops are the F18 (Lawhood Descent) instantiation (line 3917), gauge-invariant observables the F2 (Descent-Repair) instantiation (line 2381) -- substance unaffected. The claim must be stated as 'SBT recovers and conceptually unifies the gauge principle', never 'SBT derives gauge invariance / the gauge group'.

main_steps: 1. Fix the gauge theory's layer: declare the admissible experiment family {f_i} (what statistics can be measured on field configurations A).
2. Invoke the BRIDGE LEMMA (imported hypothesis) to show the induced empirical equivalence ~ on A is precisely the gauge-orbit relation (the external gauge group G enters here; honest cost).
3. Apply OI-EI: gauge-equivalent configurations, being empirically indiscernible, must be identified -- so the physical object space is A/~ = A/G.

4. Apply Leibniz factorization + definability=fiber-constancy: every layer-expressible quantity factors uniquely through q:A->A/G, i.e. the observables are exactly the gauge-invariant functions (the forced 'only gauge-invariant functions are observable' conclusion, GIVEN steps 1-2).
5. Instantiate F18: Wilson loops (traces of holonomy) are constant on gauge orbits, hence descend through q -- the canonical gauge-invariant observable as a quotient-definable function.

6. Instantiate F15a: a gauge fixing is a section sigma of q; Gribov-Singer (no continuous global equivariant section) is a non-empty selection obstruction O_s != empty, and the Faddeev-Popov local condition F(A)=0 + FP determinant is the 'declared breaker' F15a says must be added when descent fails.

7. Conclude the unification claim: gauge redundancy, decoherence pointer-quotients, no-signalling, contextuality and coarse-graining all instantiate ONE universal property (refusal of empirically silent surplus structure); gauge-fixing pathology is one instance of the generic F15a obstruction.

audit.overfitting_risk_note: LOW only in the narrow sense that nothing is numerically over-fit (there is no data); but descriptive flexibility is effectively UNBOUNDED as a derivation, since the quotient is an externally declared input.
audit.opposite_world_explanation: Decisively yes. The machinery is a content-free universal property whose output is fully determined by externally declared inputs (the gauge group G and the bridge identification). In an opposite world gauging a DIFFERENT group G', SBT would, with identical freedom and identical Lean backing, declare q:A->A/G' and 'derive' physical space = A/G' and observables = G'-invariant functions. If gauge transforms WERE observable, declare the trivial relation and get no quotient. If a configuration symmetry left all statistics invariant yet were NOT a gauge symmetry, SBT has no principle to exclude quotienting it. The selection obstruction O_s and the orbit relation are inputs, not predictions; the 'forced consequence' framing is forced only relative to a hypothesis that already encodes the answer.

audit.audit_verdict: FAIL as a derivation; PASS as an honestly-scoped class-B reorganization. Core mechanism = orbit-descent (Leibniz quotient + F2 descent + F18 lawhood + F15a selection obstruction), genuinely reused across >=2 facts (gauge observables, Wilson loops, Gribov-Singer, Noether/F27, chemistry, knots, decoherence, no-signalling) -- a real point of structural economy. The claim is admissible ONLY in the card's honest framing -- 'SBT recovers and conceptually unifies the gauge principle' -- and must NEVER be stated as 'SBT derives gauge invariance or the gauge group'. Verdict consistent with ledger disclaimers (no canonical-lens / pointer-basis principle; no continuum interface) and the paper's own hedge ('analogous to quotienting gauge redundancy', line 126, verified).
